matches.note: The Bayern Munich v 1. FC Nürnberg match from 23 April 1994, which finished with a score of 2–1, was annulled by the DFB and was required to be replayed due to Bayern Munich player Thomas Helmer scoring a ghost goal. The replay took place on 3 May 1994 and finished with a score of 5–0.
